name: Advanced Wireless Semiconductor Company
summary: Advanced Wireless Semiconductor Company engages in research, development, production, testing, and sales of gallium arsenide (GaAs) wafers in Taiwan. The company offers InGaP/GaAs heterojunction bipolar transistor process for power amplifier and gain block circuit designs; GaAs enhancement/depletion-mode pseudomorphic high electron-mobility transistor process for switch and low noise amplifier designs; and enhancement/depletion-mode integration of heterojunction bipolar and high electron-mobility transistors technology for level integration single-chip designs in smart phone and Wi-Fi applications.
